root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and face/hat, beckoning-hand, skirt-hand, bare-leg, hoof and human-foot crops. She has a very wide straw hat (c02) and stands at an isolated plantation house at the forest edge under a high sun (c07/c08). No text, aura or victim. It still fails, for three reasons. (1) The face under the brim is not hideous or malevolent. The visible lower face is a pretty, warm, open toothy smile, an ordinary attractive woman as in a fashion shoot. That contradicts c02's hideous hidden face, the malevolent disposition, and the receipt's own claim of a 'distorted cruel grin'. (2) The framing is sexualised. The camera lies on the ground looking up under the lifted skirt at a bare, oiled leg exposed past the knee into the thigh, and the low-cut bodice shows cleavage. This is the same upskirt problem rejected for irudica in 2079-r02, and it is especially inappropriate for a figure whose origin is an enslaved African woman (c01). artistic_choices claims 'no sexualized framing', which the image contradicts. (3) Blue sky with fluffy cumulus, a sparkling sun and palm trees make a sunny resort postcard, not the dead white glare of windless noon (c08) or a dangerous lure. At 200px it reads as a woman in a straw hat on a holiday path, and the hoof is the only cue. Fails Uji Sangar #2 and #7 and the policy's fidelity/respect rules.
